adapter_order: alternate per repetition within each fixture/instance-count pair
cache_condition: verified immutable inputs already materialized; warm OS cache, no attempt to flush user machine caches; fresh private disks for each build repetition; repeated launch cycles reuse one private cohort
workload: actual GCC xxHash build/upstream sanity, 2048 small files, Redis with appendfsync always, persisted-output verification
memory: report task physical footprint and resident bytes separately; no PSS claim; include controller/observer and all recursively discovered runtime/client/proxy descendants; record sampled and VMM lifetime peaks
cpu: calibrate libproc CPU units against POSIX process CPU time; record raw calibration and convert before computing one-core CPU percentages
recovery: separate real-build recovery from a controlled in-guest allocate/touch/free phase; equal 60-second windows
session_start: new pinned-key SSH command session in an already prepared VM, tiny guest readiness marker; record as substrate session, not full AI-agent completion
durability: libkrun SyncMode::Full and hvi File::sync_data -> macOS Rust 1.95 F_FULLFSYNC; no host-power-loss claim
preconditions: same common kernel and architecture-matched guest artifacts
no diagnostic unconfined or calibration row included in qualifying comparison
at least 2 GiB free host storage before each cohort; exhaustion is retained and remaining samples become not-run
failures: retain every failure/exhaustion and requested instance count; an incomplete cohort never counts as successful density
storage: count logical bytes and stat blocks*512; common verified inputs once per cohort, private disks per instance; retain standalone full-cost and amortized figures; preparation-output namespaces stay per-project
